verdict.rationale: Vue's own docs describe a "truly reactive, compiler-optimized rendering system that rarely requires manual optimization." That directly matches relying on a compiler and reactivity instead of hand-written diffing, and a community comment reports Vue performing faster than React. However, the support is a single homepage tagline with no detail on how the compiler produces targeted DOM updates. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on the template compiler and its update strategy, explicit evidence that updates are surgical or fine-grained, and independent hands-on corroboration of compiler-driven update efficiency.
